name: arcwidgets-playground
description: Jev and MCP demos using the published arcWidgets React package

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @arcrider/playground-prompt-driven-views && npm run build --workspace @arcrider/playground-mcp-table && npm run event:build && npm run renderer:build
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @arcrider/playground-prompt-driven-views && npm run test --workspace @arcrider/playground-mcp-table && npm run event:test && npm run renderer:test && npm run check:demos
scripts.check:demos: node packages/demo-kit/scripts/check-demo.mjs demos/mcp/arc-event --session --resource=ui://arc-rider/arc-event-v2.html && PLAYGROUND=1 node packages/demo-kit/scripts/check-demo.mjs demos/mcp/arcwidgets-table --resource=ui://arc-rider/arcwidgets-table.html && node packages/demo-kit/scripts/check-demo.mjs demos/mcp/arcwidgets-table --resource=ui://arc-rider/arcwidgets-table.html -- --http && PLAYGROUND=1 node packages/demo-kit/scripts/check-demo.mjs demos/mcp/arcwidgets-renderer --resource=ui://arc-rider/dynamic-table/v1.html
scripts.test:ui: npm run test:ui --workspace @arcrider/playground-prompt-driven-views && npm run test:ui --workspace @arcrider/playground-mcp-renderer
